# Company search
Send POST https://api.example-data.test/v2/company/search/es_dsl with an Elasticsearch query. It returns ids.
The next page cursor comes back in the x-next-page-after header.

# Company collect
GET https://api.example-data.test/v2/company/collect/12345 returns one company. Costs 20 credits.
GET https://api.example-data.test/v2/company/collect/67890?fields=name works the same way.

# Job search
POST https://api.example-data.test/v2/jobs/search/es_dsl

# Job collect
GET /v2/jobs/collect/{job_id}

# Subscriptions
DELETE /v2/subscriptions/{subscription_id}
